text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and C after gains but held through later declines without trading; I should avoid letting the urge to lock in winners or avoid admitting a mistake dictate decisions.","I should judge each position by its current prospects and fit with my overall portfolio, not just whether it is above or below my average cost.","Past price moves do not predict future moves, so I should manage risk and make decisions deliberately rather than react to every daily change."]}
